C-WORKSHOP-NARROW-NAV.Summary: Fix the desktop header overflow discovered during the user-requested Workshop window sweep.
C-WORKSHOP-NARROW-NAV.Problem: The full title, labelled actions and clock overflow a 600-pixel desktop window.

Goals.Goal: Keep Home, Wishlist, Profile and audio available at narrow widths with compact labelled-by-tooltip icons and a flexible title.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve existing navigation callbacks and audio behaviour.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Desktop header fits 320 through 1920 pixels and text scale 1.5; wide windows retain the existing labelled actions and clock.

Assumptions.Assumption: This bounded fix is necessary to fulfil the user's explicit request to implement and verify the Workshop at different window sizes; the failure was observed in the running app.
